57215.explanation:
Total number of people in the lift = 8 boys + 4 girls

= 12 people

probability that a boy comes out = \(\frac{8}{12}\) = \(\frac{2}{3}\)

57261.subject: Mathematics
57261.question_text: Make b the subject of the relation lb = \(\frac{1}{2}\) (a + b)h
57261.explanation:
lb = \(\frac{1}{2} (a + b)h

2lb = ah + bh

2lb - bh = ah

\(\frac{b(2l - h)}{2l - h} = \frac{ah}{2l - h}\)

b = \(\frac{ah}{2l - h}\)

57384.explanation:
E\(G\)R = 50\(^o\)  (Alternative angles) 

n + 55\(^o\) + 50\(^o\) = 180\(^o\)  (Sum of angles on a straight line) 

n = 180\(^o\) - 105\(^o\)

n = 75\(^o\)
